plan.title: Resume-contract delivery presses Enter into the session-resume gate, silently choosing "Resume from summary" over the operator's "as-is"
plan.author: agent:k3[1m]

narratives.Problem: The issue's three-bullet fix is already merged to origin/main as fac085ef4e (paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu guard mode, sendKeys MessageDeliveryFailed abort, handleConversationResume gate skip), but the two new behavior branches have no branch-level tests, and one sibling Enter path — completeKeyedSubmit's if-shell transaction in src/lib/tmux-dedup.ts — still has no blocking-menu guard. A regression in any of these re-opens the incident: a stray Enter answering a harness modal (resume gate, permission prompt, plan approval) the operator never asked Overdeck to answer.
narratives.Proposal: Residual hardening in three independent items: (1) unit-test the sendKeys blocking-menu guard with the established execFile-mock + fake-timers pattern; (2) extract the resume gate-skip into an exported seam (src/lib/overdeck/resume-contract-delivery.ts) and unit-test its four outcomes; (3) extend paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu to completeKeyedSubmit via a KeyedTmuxDeps.readPaneText seam, aborting before the if-shell Enter with the pending marker preserved, plus a one-sentence CLAUDE.md doc update.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Re-implementing the merged fix (fac085ef4e) — verified present on origin/main.
- Guarding the summary-fork standalone-Enter nudge (src/lib/overdeck/conversation-forks.ts:368-369) — pane-verified, capped at two Enters by design.
- Changing PTY supervisor delivery semantics — it already purges unconfirmed payloads rather than pressing Enter.
- Guarding sendKeys's post-submit re-Enter (src/lib/tmux.ts:1262-1266) — fires only after a verified paste in an active composer.
- Retroactive recovery of conv/1466 — its history is intact in a55576b8-538a-4056-b0bd-5e6bfc3cc4fb.jsonl per the issue.
- Changing the keyed path's marker/poison/terminal transaction semantics (cycles 10-13) beyond the pre-transaction abort.

autoDecisions.summary: Plan residual hardening (tests + keyed-path guard) instead of implementing the issue's fix.
autoDecisions.rationale: The fix described in the issue body is already merged to origin/main as fac085ef4e — verified in code: guard mode in src/lib/pane-choice-menu.ts:270, MessageDeliveryFailed abort at src/lib/tmux.ts:1237-1243, gate skip at src/lib/overdeck/conversation-runtime.ts:906-912, 28 parser tests green. Re-implementing would be wasted work; the defensible residual is locking the behavior with tests.

autoDecisions.summary: Extend the never-answer-a-menu guard to completeKeyedSubmit.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue's root-cause section explicitly generalizes the blast radius to any delivery path that can confirm a modal's default, and the keyed path's if-shell Enter (src/lib/tmux-dedup.ts:434-439) was the only remaining path with no menu check. The abort-before-transaction design preserves the pending marker for retry, so availability is unaffected.

autoDecisions.summary: Extract the resume gate-skip into a new module rather than unit-testing handleConversationResume in place.
autoDecisions.rationale: handleConversationResume calls same-module spawnConversationSession/waitForConversationRuntimeReady, which vi.mock cannot intercept without replacing the function under test. Extraction gives a clean seam, keeps behavior byte-equivalent, and shrinks the allowlisted god file conversation-runtime.ts instead of growing it.

items.title: Unit-test the sendKeys blocking-menu guard (merged in fac085ef4e)

expected_outputs: menu-scenario test asserts zero send-keys C-m exec calls

narrative.Action: Create tests/lib/tmux-send-keys-blocking-menu.test.ts modeled on tests/lib/tmux-send-escape.test.ts: vi.hoisted execFileMock + vi.mock('child_process'), config-yaml mock with tmux.configMode 'inherit-user', vi.useFakeTimers(). The execFile mock dispatches on tmux subcommand: load-buffer/paste-buffer/delete-buffer succeed; capture-pane returns the scenario pane text (resume-gate menu fixture reused VERBATIM from tests/lib/pane-choice-menu.test.ts, or a clear composer, or text containing the verify line); send-keys calls are recorded. Drive Effect.runPromise(sendKeys('conv-test', '<3+ char verify line payload>')) and advance timers past VERIFY_TIMEOUT_MS 1500 × PASTE_MAX_ATTEMPTS 2 (src/lib/tmux.ts:1186-1188) with vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync. Tests: (1) menu scenario → rejects with MessageDeliveryFailed and NO exec call with args ['send-keys','-t','conv-test','C-m']; (2) composer scenario, paste never verifies, no menu → resolves, exactly one C-m sent (fail-open preserved); (3) verify line visible → resolves, exactly one C-m, no error. See PRD WI-1 for the full dispatch spec.

items.title: Menu scenario: sendKeys rejects with MessageDeliveryFailed and no execFile call carries ['send-keys','-t','conv-test','C-m'] args
Composer scenario (no menu, unverified paste): sendKeys resolves and sends exactly one C-m, preserving fail-open behavior
Verified-paste scenario: sendKeys resolves with exactly one C-m and no error; all tests use vi.useFakeTimers, no real setTimeout waits
Extract resume gate-skip into resume-contract-delivery.ts seam and unit-test it

expected_outputs: handleConversationResume no longer contains the inline paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu block

narrative.Action: Move the gate-check + best-effort delivery block at src/lib/overdeck/conversation-runtime.ts:902-922 into a new exported function deliverResumeContractUnlessGated(tmuxSession, contract, caller, method) in new module src/lib/overdeck/resume-contract-delivery.ts, returning 'delivered' | 'skipped-gated' | 'failed'. Imports: capturePaneText from '../tmux.js', deliverAgentMessage from '../agents.js', paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu from '../pane-choice-menu.js'. Keep the exact log strings and catch semantics (capture failure → '' → delivery attempted; delivery failure → console.error + 'failed', never throws). Replace the block in handleConversationResume with a single await deliverResumeContractUnlessGated(conv.tmuxSession, `CONVERSATION RESUME: ${buildResumeContract(resumeCause)}`, 'conversation-resume', resolveConversationDeliveryMethod(conv)) and keep the operator-owns-the-gate comment. New test tests/unit/lib/overdeck/resume-contract-delivery.test.ts mocks ../../../../src/lib/tmux.js and ../../../../src/lib/agents.js (pattern: src/lib/overdeck/__tests__/conversation-delivery.test.ts:28-49): (1) gated pane → 'skipped-gated', deliverAgentMessage not called; (2) clear composer → deliverAgentMessage called with (session, contract, caller, method), 'delivered'; (3) capturePaneText rejects → delivery attempted, 'delivered' (fail-open); (4) deliverAgentMessage rejects → 'failed', no throw. Full before/after snippet in PRD WI-2.

items.title: deliverResumeContractUnlessGated returns 'skipped-gated' and never calls deliverAgentMessage when capturePaneText returns a blocking-menu pane
Returns 'delivered' and calls deliverAgentMessage with (session, contract, caller, method) on a clear pane, and also when capturePaneText rejects (fail-open)
Returns 'failed' without throwing when deliverAgentMessage rejects; handleConversationResume calls the seam and its inline paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu block is removed; typecheck passes
Guard completeKeyedSubmit's if-shell Enter against blocking choice menus

expected_outputs: all tmux-dedup tests pass including the new menu-abort case

narrative.Action: In src/lib/tmux-dedup.ts: (1) extend the './tmux.js' import (line 40) with capturePaneText and MessageDeliveryFailed, and import paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu from './pane-choice-menu.js' (no cycle — pane-choice-menu imports nothing, tmux.ts does not import tmux-dedup). (2) Add `readPaneText?: (sessionName: string, lines: number) => Promise<string>` to KeyedTmuxDeps (lines 188-194). (3) In completeKeyedSubmit (line 401), after the preTarget/pendingBefore reads and BEFORE the if-shell exec (line 434): when pendingBefore is non-empty, read the pane via deps.readPaneText ?? capturePaneText with .catch(() => '') and throw MessageDeliveryFailed (message naming the menu, session, snapshot) if paneHasBlockingChoiceMenu is true — aborting before any Enter so the pending marker survives for retry. Do not touch the if-shell condition or marker logic (cycles 10-13 invariants). Tests in src/lib/__tests__/tmux-dedup.test.ts: (a) pure-unit — deps readMarker returns the pending send-id, readPaneTarget a live target, readPaneText the resume-gate fixture → rejects with MessageDeliveryFailed before any terminal write; (b) real-server — readPaneText returning busy-composer text → terminal marker set, proving legitimate submits are not blocked. Docs: append one sentence to the tmux-fallback paragraph of CLAUDE.md's 'PTY supervisor for orchestrator delivery' section noting the keyed dedup submit applies the same guard before its if-shell Enter. Exact code snippet in PRD WI-3.

items.title: completeKeyedSubmit rejects with MessageDeliveryFailed before the if-shell exec when readPaneText returns a blocking-menu pane, leaving the pending marker intact for retry
completeKeyedSubmit sends the Enter and sets the terminal marker when readPaneText returns a normal busy composer or when the pane capture fails
KeyedTmuxDeps exposes readPaneText; CLAUDE.md's delivery section now states the keyed dedup submit applies the same blocking-menu guard; typecheck passes
